hero_kpi_rationale_en: Occupancy rate of 94.1% reflecting rental health and tenant demand in owned properties, a key performance indicator in the retail real estate sector.

ai_positioning.summary_en: FRT takes a defensive approach to AI, emphasizing cybersecurity risk management related to its internal use rather than strategic deployment. The company has implemented policies and control procedures to govern AI use.
